description.fullstack: Enterprise AI engine orchestrating the generation of complex government documents. Leverages native RAG and strict JSON Schemas to mitigate hallucinations and reduce weeks of bureaucratic labor to minutes.

description.ai: Prompt engineering anchored in rigid system constraints and mandatory JSON Mode, ensuring zero technical hallucinations during the formulation of critical legal contracts (ETP, DFD).
description.devops: Strict CI/CD pipeline focused on frictionless deployment of the AI engine, combined with intensive background Worker queue monitoring to prevent deadlocks under high government concurrency.
